avis.texte: The sunscreen feels amazing on the skin and doesn't seem to break me out. However, I wish they had an untinted option. It works well if I have a spray tan during the summer time, otherwise, it's a little too dark for my fair skin tone. Please, Cetaphil, offer this formulation in an untinted version too!

could be perfect! doesn't make me oily or dry me out with my sensitive combo skin. also doesn't break me out which is so rare. so close to perfect but this would be amazing with other shade ranges.We need one with a cool pink undertone for us pale girls and i know that other women need a darker range. very few people are this shade of orange! is a case of trying to make something for everyone and falling short :( Please make more shades and i know it'll fly off the shelves!

This is one of my favorite daily sunscreens🌞 The texture is a little bit thicker than other sunscreens that I have used before, but it feels very lightweight when you apply it, and it spreads really nicely. I find this moisturizing without that greasy feeling sensation. This is perfect for no makeup days! I love its sheer tint because it blends so seamlessly.

I really love the coverage and feel of this tinted moisturizer. I've been on the hunt for an affordable mineral-based sunscreen. The coverage is buildable & glowy. My only issue has been with the pump—it tends to cause me issues getting the product. But even then I'd still repurchase!

avis.titre: Love the ingredients / Hate the shade range
avis.texte: I love the way this spf feels on my skin, & the calming ingredients like licorice in it are a huge bonus. However, it is WAY too orange on my light skin tone. I've tried making it work by putting a non-tinted spf underneath, to no avail. I really wish this brand would listen to its consumers & create a better shade range for all skin tones.. Guess I'll have to switch over to Cerave until then & I'm happy they have better options now. Sucks, bc I love Cetaphil products. Please Cetaphil, make more shades, myself & so many other pale girlies would be back!

avis.titre: Formula feels great but is so orange
avis.texte: I wish this worked for me, but it is too orange. It's such a shame because this is one of the best feeling formulas I've ever tried for tinted sunscreen, but it makes me look like a Cheeto.

avis.titre: Would be better if it didn't oxidize
avis.texte: I like that this sunscreen is fragrance free, has simple ingredients, and blends like a lotion. However, if you use the recommended 1/4 teaspoon to get the full SPF 40 coverage, this formula oxidizes and turns your face completely orange. If I only apply 3-4 pumps, I am mostly fine, but I am not sure that I am getting the coverage that is advertised.
The shades don't go light enough, as a fairer skinned girly that needs tinted protection, it's not even close to my shade. And I'm not even that light skinned.

avis.titre: Could never replace this tinted spf

avis.titre: Love the formula but don't love the color.

The only thing I don't like is the color, it's too light to where makes my medium Asian skin tone too white, my face color doesn't match my brown arms. I have to use bronzing drops underneath the sunscreen to get more color. If you can make a medium version of this tinted sunscreen, you'd have a customer for life. I also love the upside down pump, I'm a sucker for good packaging.

avis.titre: Wow! This tinted sunscreen in awesome!
avis.texte: Solid 5 stars for this sunscreen. I found this tinted mineral sunscreen and I'm so so happy! I use it over my moisturizer and my skin feels hydrated and looks glowy. It does not feel greasy or oily. I personally prefer a matte finish, so I apply a minimal amount of translucent powder on top. But other than translucent powder, I basically don't apply any more make up. Stays on pretty smoothly throughout the day. I even reapplied in the afternoon, and it still looked good. It doesn't accentuate any fine lines. And it matched my skin color very well. I did have a small area on my face that was a bit red and irritated (for a different reason unrelated to this sunscreen), this tinted sunscreen did neutralize and hide the redness. An overall winner. So happy!

I wear a full face of makeup everyday so my one layer of spf in the morning is all I do and I will touch up if needed with a spray spf later over my makeup. Currently though I do think I would repurchase this.

Finally!!! After trying SO many different tinted face sunscreens, I have landed on the perfect one with this product! I have purchased many different tinted spf options, from several brands with different price points, and this is, hands-down, the best. I have light/medium skin tone and this formula blends in perfectly, while blurring pores and skin redness. My combination/sensitive skin feels moisturized, but isn't greasy with this sunscreen. I use this in place of foundation or CC cream, so can't attest to how it layers under those products, but it pairs wonderfully with my under-eye concealer. I'm so excited to have found "Cetaphil Everyday Sunscreen Tinted Face Lotion" and I highly recommend it!

Also compared to other sunscreens I've tried this also never quite dried down on my face, like it always had a slippery feel to even hours after applying (I even used setting poweder to see if it helped). I will say though I never experienced any piling with this product and there isn't really a fragrance either. I would also say that if you are any darker than a light-medium skin tone this will probably be too light for you. I range between light-medium during the winter and medium during the summer months and this matches me perfectly for my winter shade but will definitely be too light once I get a little color.

A lot of mineral sunscreens leave a white-cast, shiny film on me. They also feel like i have a layer of vaseline on my face. This one looks and feels like makeup. It doesnt look like i have anything on my face, but it helps conceal any redness and evens everything out, plus protects me from some sun damage. I wouldnt rely on just this if i planned to spend a lot of time outside (Its just a small ammount) but for day to day, intermittent sun exposure, it's great. I love it.

I'll start out by saying this is not a bad product, I just…wish I liked it more. It's an affordable SPF 40 tinted mineral sunscreen that is fragrence free. I went into using this expecting and hoping to love it. However, the tint is quite orange-y, and initial application gives some "peanut butter baby" vibes. Also, I'm not sure which ingredient it is exactly, but after initial application my skin starts to tingle in an almost uncomfortable way. Perhaps the caffeine, which I've never had an issue with having it in skincare in the past and given its antioxidant properties and benefits of improving UVB protection I was all for having it, but as it is higher up in the ingredient list, I wonder if the concentration is a little too strong for me. Overall, I don't hate this. Once it has had some time to be on the skin it doesn't look quite so dewy/borderline greasy (which I don't hate but if you already have oily skin I would keep this in mind.) I would not say this is very hydrating and would recommend using a moisturizer under this. I don't think I'll buy it again, but I'm going to use it up.

avis.titre: Game changer for daily skin care
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've tried countless tinted sunscreens, but Cetaphil Sun Everyday Face Tinted Lotion truly stands out as a holy grail product. From the first application, I was impressed by how effortlessly it blends into the skin, leaving a beautiful, natural-looking tint that evens out my complexion without feeling heavy or cakey. My entire family used this on a recent trip, including my teenage sons who never use a tinted sunscreen because they look too makeup-y. This finish was just naturally sheer without the typical white cast. One of the best things about this lotion is how lightweight and non-greasy it feels. It absorbs quickly, doesn't clog my pores, and gives my skin a healthy, radiant finish. Plus, the SPF protection is a huge bonus – I feel confident stepping out into the sun knowing my skin is protected. What I really appreciate is how gentle it is. I have sensitive skin and my son has acne-prone skin, and this product hasn't caused a single breakout. In fact, it feels soothing and hydrating, almost like a moisturizer with bonus coverage and sun protection. It's also fragrance-free, which is perfect for anyone with sensitivity to scents. This is my go-to product. It's easy, effective, and makes me feel polished with minimal effort. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a multitasking daily skincare essential. Cetaphil nailed it with one!

avis.texte: I've been using the Cetaphil Sun Everyday Sunscreen Tinted Face Lotion SPF 40 daily for a few weeks now, and I'm blown away by the results. My skin looks and feels healthier, and I've noticed a significant reduction in redness and irritation. If you have sensitive skin, look no further! The Cetaphil Sun Everyday Sunscreen Tinted Face Lotion SPF 40 is a must-have. Its soothing, hydrating, and protective properties make it an excellent choice for anyone seeking a reliable and gentle sunscreen. I'm absolutely thrilled with the Cetaphil Sun Everyday Sunscreen Tinted Face Lotion SPF 40! As someone with extremely sensitive skin, I've struggled to find a sunscreen that not only protects my skin but also soothes and hydrates it.
